verdict.rationale: Figma's first-party AI page says the built-in Figma agent can "edit images" and generate design directions inside the editor, with team AI credits to pay for usage. That covers the core idea of in-editor AI, but the specific asset chores are not documented as named features. Missing for 10: explicit image generation, background removal, content-aware fill, copy/text suggestion features, and independent hands-on corroboration of the image-editing tools.
